literature.headline_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期重点文献按发表日期、相关性、证据等级和研究质量综合排序，研究结果与综述证据分别核验后形成以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在已确定的四种 CHIKV 抑制剂中,二盐酸依米丁 (ED) 能够有效抑制小鼠模型中的 CHIKV 复制,从而显着降低病毒血症水平,并且用 ED 治疗的 CHIKV 感染小鼠没有表现出关节肿胀的临床症状。 [10.1186/s12929-026-01280-9]
尽管观察到高度异质性,但所有亚组分析都表现出较高的整体表现。 [10.1111/tmi.70203]
分别有 80% 和 90% 的病例出现皮疹和全身无力。 [10.3329/iahsmj.v8i2.91476]
慢性关节痛患者与无慢性关节痛患者之间的比较相关性显示,与疾病发作时出现皮疹、中度至重度关节疼痛和肿胀显着相关(p 值<0.05)。 [10.3205/dgkh000664]
本综述介绍了杀虫剂耐药性的现状、其潜在机制以及全球耐药性趋势。 [10.1007/s11033-026-12410-9]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.caveats_zh: 部分证据来自摘要、观察性研究或叙述性综述，结论应结合研究设计和证据等级理解。
literature.lead_en: This literature brief prioritizes publications in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency and source convergence.
key_findings_en: Out of the four CHIKV inhibitors identified, emetine dihydrochloride (ED) potently inhibited CHIKV replication in the mouse model, yielding significantly lower viremia levels, and CHIKV-infected mice treated with ED showed no clinical symptoms of joint swelling. [10.1186/s12929-026-01280-9]
Despite the high heterogeneity observed, all subgroup analyses demonstrated high overall performance. [10.1111/tmi.70203]
Rash and generalized weakness were observed in 80% and 90% of cases, respectively. [10.3329/iahsmj.v8i2.91476]

A comparative correlation between patients of chronic arthralgia and no chronic arthralgia showed significant association with presence of rashes, moderate to severe joint pain and swelling at the disease onset (p value <0.05). [10.3205/dgkh000664]
This review presents the current status of insecticide resistance, its underlying mechanisms, and global trends in resistance. [10.1007/s11033-026-12410-9]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.caveats_en: Some evidence is abstract-only, observational or derived from narrative reviews; conclusions should be interpreted in light of study design and evidence strength.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.

news.headline_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期新闻资格由来源、日期、正文身份和相关性终审决定；中文翻译状态不影响有效新闻的保留。中文字段不可用时，本区域使用已核验英文内容填充。
key_findings_zh: CDC 关于基孔肯雅热风险地区的指南,包括美国当前的疫情和高风险地区。该内容是信息资源,而不是特定疫情事件的报告。 [news-d5de9d613c2dbb63]
由于血液中病毒含量较高,传播也可能通过以下方式发生: 输血(可能) 在实验室中接触病毒 病毒不会通过咳嗽、打喷嚏或触摸在人与人之间传播。 [news-0a313a9e5c7c74e7]
研究人员开发了一种高度灵敏的便携式测试条(mbLFIA),无需复杂的实验室设备即可直观地检测超低水平的基孔肯雅病毒。该技术处于临床前阶段,尚未准备好用于常规临床使用。 [news-8950bd8125e22939]
一个研究小组使用基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)作为模型靶标,开发了一种多位点桥接介导的侧流免疫测定(mbLFIA),用于高灵敏度、便携式检测蚊媒病毒。该方法对 CHIKV 的视觉检测限低至 2 pmol·L−1。 [news-0ffec2af4c9142f4]
截至大使馆发出警报时,据报道已有 45 起疑似病例,影响到当地人,当然也包括游客。 [news-092bfacf3f7cdff4]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.caveats_zh: 中文翻译不完整时会以英文证据填充中文显示位置，并在后台记录translation_status=english_fallback。
news.lead_en: News eligibility is determined by source, date, body identity and final relevance. Translation completeness does not determine whether an eligible report is retained.
key_findings_en: CDC guidance on areas at risk for chikungunya, including current outbreaks and elevated-risk locations for U.S. The content is an informational resource, not a report of a specific outbreak event. [news-d5de9d613c2dbb63]

Because of the high level of virus in blood, spread can also occur through: Blood transfusion (probable) Exposure to the virus in the laboratory The virus does not spread from person to person through coughing, sneezing, or touching. [news-0a313a9e5c7c74e7]

Researchers have developed a highly sensitive, portable test strip (mbLFIA) that visually detects chikungunya virus at ultralow levels without complex laboratory equipment. The technology is in the preclinical stage and not yet ready for routine clinical use. [news-8950bd8125e22939]

A research team developed a multisite bridging-mediated lateral flow immunoassay (mbLFIA) for highly sensitive, portable detection of mosquito-borne viruses, using Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) as a model target. The method achieved a visual detection limit as low as 2 pmol·L−1 for CHIKV. [news-0ffec2af4c9142f4]
As of the Embassy's alert, it's being reported there have been 45 suspected cases affecting locals, and yes, tourists too. [news-092bfacf3f7cdff4]

papers.title: Diagnostic Accuracy of Real Time Reverse Transcriptase Polymerase Chain Reaction for Chikungunya Virus Detection: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an arbovirus that causes an acute febrile illness with intense muscle and joint pain, with the possibility of progressing to a chronic or neurological stage. We conducted a systematic review and meta‐analysis with the aim of evaluating the accuracy of real‐time reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction (RT‐qPCR) protocols for detecting CHIKV during the acute phase of symptoms. Methods We searched the literature until December 5, 2024, including English, Portuguese, and Spanish, with no time restriction in PubMed, LILACS, and Web of Science. Studies that evaluated RT‐qPCR protocols compared to reference techniques such as viral isolation or validated RT‐qPCRs were included in the study. We collected data on sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, study design and methodological characteristics of RT‐qPCR. Quadas‐2 tool was used to assess the risk of bias and applicability. Subsequently, a meta‐analysis and meta‐regression were performed. Results Twenty‐eight protocols were included in this systematic review, 28 index tests were extracted and 24 were included in quantitative analysis. According to meta‐analysis, RT‐qPCR for CHIKV detection had a combined accuracy of 96% (95% CI: 94 to 99%) and a summary sensitivity and specificity of 99.7% and 99.7%, respectively; however, the results need to be interpreted considering the high heterogeneity (78.1%) and publication bias ( p = 0.002). Conclusion RT‐qPCR is a highly accurate technique for detecting the Chikungunya virus during the acute phase of symptoms. Despite the high heterogeneity observed, all subgroup analyses demonstrated high overall performance.

papers.title: Emetine dihydrochloride inhibits Chikungunya virus nsP2 helicase and shows robust antiviral activity in cells and mice
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), a mosquito-borne alphavirus, causes frequent global epidemics of chikungunya fever, characterized by severe joint pain and debilitating arthritis. With no specific antiviral therapies available, these outbreaks pose a major public health challenge, particularly in tropical regions. There is thus urgent need to develop novel antivirals. Drug repurposing is an attractive strategy to identify potential antivirals targeting CHIKV replication. Methods The Spectrum collection of approved drugs was screened using high-content cell imaging to identify potential CHIKV replication inhibitors. Efficacy of these CHIKV inhibitors was evaluated in a C57BL/6 mouse model of chikungunya disease, monitoring viremia and clinical symptoms like joint swelling. The CHIKV inhibitor's effect on virus uptake, replication, RNA synthesis, and protein production was studied in ERMS cells. In silico molecular docking was used to study the inhibitor’s binding to the CHIKV proteins. Binding was validated in vitro using microscale thermophoresis and isothermal titration calorimetry. CHIKV helicase, protease, and ATPase activities were measured in the presence of emetine dihydrochloride (ED) to determine its mechanism of action. Results Out of the four CHIKV inhibitors identified by high content screening, ED potently inhibited CHIKV replication in the mouse model, yielding significantly lower viremia levels. Notably, CHIKV-infected mice treated with ED showed no clinical symptoms of joint swelling. In ERMS cells, ED blocked CHIKV uptake and early replication by suppressing viral RNA synthesis, which in turn prevented viral protein production. Computational modelling predicted ED’s binding around the RNA-binding site of the CHIKV nsP2 helicase domain. In vitro validation confirmed dose-dependent ED binding with CHIKV nsP2. ED specifically inhibited helicase unwinding in a concentration-dependent manner without affecting ATPase or protease activity. Conclusions This study demonstrates that ED inhibits CHIKV replication in cultured cells and a mouse model of infection through binding to CHIKV nsP2 and inhibition of its helicase activity. While this is a promising virus-targeted mechanism of ED’s antiviral action, additional host-directed mechanisms warrant further investigation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 在全球范围内频繁流行,导致严重关节疼痛和衰弱性关节炎,对公共卫生构成重大挑战,特别是在热带地区,目前尚无特效抗病毒疗法,因此需要开发新型抗病毒药物。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用高内涵细胞成像筛选了已批准药物的 Spectrum 系列,以识别潜在的 CHIKV 复制抑制剂,评估基孔肯雅病 C57BL/6 小鼠模型的疗效,监测病毒血症和关节肿胀等临床症状。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用高内涵细胞成像来筛选已批准的 CHIKV 复制抑制剂药物的 Spectrum 系列,在 C57BL/6 小鼠模型中评估疗效,并研究抑制剂对 ERMS 细胞中病毒摄取、复制、RNA 合成和蛋白质产生的影响,并使用计算机分子对接、微型热泳法和等温滴定量热法进行结合验证。
elements_zh.main_results: 在已确定的四种 CHIKV 抑制剂中,二盐酸依米丁 (ED) 能够有效抑制小鼠模型中的 CHIKV 复制,从而显着降低病毒血症水平,并且用 ED 治疗的 CHIKV 感染小鼠没有表现出关节肿胀的临床症状。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,ED 通过与 CHIKV nsP2 结合并抑制其解旋酶活性,抑制培养细胞和感染小鼠模型中的 CHIKV 复制,其他宿主导向机制值得进一步研究。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,ED 可能是 CHIKV 的一种潜在抗病毒疗法,通过抑制 nsP2 解旋酶提供一种新的作用机制,这可以为未来的药物开发和治疗策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究没有调查 ED 抗病毒作用的其他宿主导向机制,研究结果基于小鼠模型和体外验证,可能无法完全转化为人类临床环境。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 在全球范围内频繁流行,导致严重关节疼痛和衰弱性关节炎,对公共卫生构成重大挑战,特别是在热带地区,目前尚无特效抗病毒疗法,因此需要开发新型抗病毒药物。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用高内涵细胞成像筛选了已批准药物的 Spectrum 系列,以识别潜在的 CHIKV 复制抑制剂,评估基孔肯雅病 C57BL/6 小鼠模型的疗效,监测病毒血症和关节肿胀等临床症状。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究使用高内涵细胞成像来筛选已批准的 CHIKV 复制抑制剂药物的 Spectrum 系列,在 C57BL/6 小鼠模型中评估疗效,并研究抑制剂对 ERMS 细胞中病毒摄取、复制、RNA 合成和蛋白质产生的影响,并使用计算机分子对接、微型热泳法和等温滴定量热法进行结合验证。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在已确定的四种 CHIKV 抑制剂中,二盐酸依米丁 (ED) 能够有效抑制小鼠模型中的 CHIKV 复制,从而显着降低病毒血症水平,并且用 ED 治疗的 CHIKV 感染小鼠没有表现出关节肿胀的临床症状。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,ED 通过与 CHIKV nsP2 结合并抑制其解旋酶活性,抑制培养细胞和感染小鼠模型中的 CHIKV 复制,其他宿主导向机制值得进一步研究。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,ED 可能是 CHIKV 的一种潜在抗病毒疗法,通过抑制 nsP2 解旋酶提供一种新的作用机制,这可以为未来的药物开发和治疗策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究没有调查 ED 抗病毒作用的其他宿主导向机制,研究结果基于小鼠模型和体外验证,可能无法完全转化为人类临床环境。

papers.title: Clinical Characteristics of Acute Chikungunya Cases at IAHS Hospital
papers.abstract: Background: Between April and September 2017, Bangladesh experienced a major outbreak of acute Chikungunya Virus (CHIKV) infection. Since then, Chikungunya has become a common cause of acute febrile illness associated with joint pain in the country. During outbreaks, dengue infection frequently co-circulates and presents with overlapping clinical features, creating diagnostic challenges. To describe the clinical and laboratory characteristics of acute Chikungunya virus infection among patients attending IAHS Hospital. Materials and methods: This cross-sectional descriptive study was conducted in the Outpatient Department of Medicine at IAHS Hospital from March 2025 to August 2025 on 50 patients. Cases presenting with acute febrile illness and joint symptoms were evaluated clinically and investigated serologically. Anti-Chikungunya IgM antibody testing was performed for laboratory confirmation. Results: Fever and joint swelling were present in 100% of patients. Rash and generalized weakness were observed in 80% and 90% of cases, respectively. Male patients constituted 60% of the study population. Lymphadenopathy was noted in 40% of patients. An oligoarticular pattern of joint involvement (60%) was more common than a polyarticular pattern (40%). Large joint involvement predominated, with ankle joint involvement seen in 80% of cases. All patients were positive for anti-Chikungunya IgM antibodies. Dengue–Chikungunya co-infection was identified in four patients. Conclusion: Chikungunya virus infection is an important cause of acute febrile illness with joint pain in Bangladesh. Given its clinical overlap with dengue and other febrile illnesses, accurate laboratory confirmation is essential for appropriate diagnosis and management. IAHS Medical Journal Vol 8(2), December 2025; 19-23

papers.title_zh: IAHS 医院急性基孔肯雅热病例的临床特征
papers.source_body_en: Background: Between April and September 2017, Bangladesh experienced a major outbreak of acute Chikungunya Virus (CHIKV) infection. Since then, Chikungunya has become a common cause of acute febrile illness associated with joint pain in the country. During outbreaks, dengue infection frequently co-circulates and presents with overlapping clinical features, creating diagnostic challenges. To describe the clinical and laboratory characteristics of acute Chikungunya virus infection among patients attending IAHS Hospital. Materials and methods: This cross-sectional descriptive study was conducted in the Outpatient Department of Medicine at IAHS Hospital from March 2025 to August 2025 on 50 patients. Cases presenting with acute febrile illness and joint symptoms were evaluated clinically and investigated serologically. Anti-Chikungunya IgM antibody testing was performed for laboratory confirmation. Results: Fever and joint swelling were present in 100% of patients. Rash and generalized weakness were observed in 80% and 90% of cases, respectively. Male patients constituted 60% of the study population. Lymphadenopathy was noted in 40% of patients. An oligoarticular pattern of joint involvement (60%) was more common than a polyarticular pattern (40%). Large joint involvement predominated, with ankle joint involvement seen in 80% of cases. All patients were positive for anti-Chikungunya IgM antibodies. Dengue–Chikungunya co-infection was identified in four patients. Conclusion: Chikungunya virus infection is an important cause of acute febrile illness with joint pain in Bangladesh. Given its clinical overlap with dengue and other febrile illnesses, accurate laboratory confirmation is essential for appropriate diagnosis and management. IAHS Medical Journal Vol 8(2), December 2025; 19-23
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:2017年4月至9月,孟加拉国爆发了一次急性基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)感染的大规模疫情。从那时起,基孔肯雅热已成为该国与关节疼痛相关的急性发热性疾病的常见原因。在疫情爆发期间,登革热感染经常同时循环并呈现重叠的临床特征,从而造成诊断挑战。描述 IAHS 医院患者急性基孔肯雅病毒感染的临床和实验室特征。材料和方法:这项横断面描述性研究于 2025 年 3 月至 2025 年 8 月在 IAHS 医院门诊医学部对 50 名患者进行。对出现急性发热性疾病和关节症状的病例进行临床评估并进行血清学调查。进行抗基孔肯雅热 IgM 抗体检测以进行实验室确认。结果:100%的患者出现发热和关节肿胀。分别有 80% 和 90% 的病例出现皮疹和全身无力。男性患者占研究人群的 60%。40% 的患者出现淋巴结肿大。关节受累的少关节模式(60%)比多关节模式(40%)更常见。大关节受累为主,80% 的病例可见踝关节受累。所有患者的抗基孔肯雅热 IgM 抗体均呈阳性。在四名患者中发现了登革热-基孔肯雅热混合感染。结论:基孔肯雅病毒感染是孟加拉国急性发热性疾病关节痛的重要原因。鉴于其临床与登革热和其他发热性疾病的重叠,准确的实验室确认对于适当的诊断和管理至关重要。IAHS 医学杂志第 8(2) 卷,2025 年 12 月;19-23日

papers.title: Predictors of chronic arthralgia following chikungunya virus infection
papers.abstract: Objectives: Chikungunya is a viral illness marked by fever and joint pain. While usually self-limiting, up to 43% may develop chronic arthralgia. The objective of this study is to evaluate the frequency and predictors of prolonged joint pain (>90 d) following Chikungunya infection, with limited data available from North India. Methods: A prospective observational study was conducted at a North Indian tertiary care hospital from September 2023 to December 2023 among adults with lab-confirmed Chikungunya. A total of 56 patients were followed up to 4 months to assess joint pain duration and severity. Data were collected through clinical exams and interviews during initial workup and follow up. Results: All patients had joint pain; 23% reported joint pain lasting for more than 90 days. The ankle was the most commonly affected joint (35.7%), followed by the knee (25%) and metacarpophalangeal joints (21.4%). A comparative correlation between patients of chronic arthralgia and no chronic arthralgia showed significant association with presence of rashes, moderate to severe joint pain and swelling at the disease onset (p value <0.05). Conclusion: In the present study, moderate to severe joint pain, joint swelling, and skin rashes at disease onset were found to be the predictors of prolonged arthralgia.

papers.abstract_zh: 目标:基孔肯雅热是一种以发烧和关节痛为特征的病毒性疾病。虽然通常是自限性的,但高达 43% 的患者可能会出现慢性关节痛。本研究的目的是评估基孔肯雅热感染后长期关节疼痛(> 90天)的频率和预测因素,来自印度北部的数据有限。方法:2023 年 9 月至 2023 年 12 月在北印度一家三级护理医院对实验室确诊的基孔肯雅热成人患者进行了一项前瞻性观察性研究。共有 56 名患者接受了长达 4 个月的随访,以评估关节疼痛的持续时间和严重程度。数据是通过初始检查和随访期间的临床检查和访谈收集的。结果:所有患者均出现关节疼痛;23% 的人表示关节疼痛持续超过 90 天。踝关节是最常受影响的关节(35.7%),其次是膝关节(25%)和掌指关节(21.4%)。慢性关节痛患者与无慢性关节痛患者之间的比较相关性显示,与疾病发作时出现皮疹、中度至重度关节疼痛和肿胀显着相关(p 值<0.05)。结论:在本研究中,发现发病时中度至重度关节疼痛、关节肿胀和皮疹是长期关节痛的预测因素。

papers.title: The Resurgence of Oropouche Virus: A Review on Evolution, Epidemiology, Pathophysiology, Vaccine Development and Global Health Preparedness
papers.abstract: The Oropouche virus (OROV) is an emerging arbovirus grouped under Orthobunyavirus genus of Peribunyaviridae family, first identified in Trinidad and Tobago in 1955, and re-emerged as a serious public health concern in the Central and South Americas. Recently, numbers of OROV cases are on the rise with the 2024 outbreak documenting over 12,000 cases across endemic and newly affected regions, including first-time detections in Caribbean nations and imported cases in the United States, Canada, and Italy. The OROV has caused over 5,00,000 cases globally, with substantial underreporting owing to clinical similarities with Zika, chikungunya and dengue. The virus is mainly transmitted by midges viz. Culicoides paraensis (Goeldi), though alternative vectors such as Culex quinquefasciatus Say and Aedes serratus (Theobald) have also been identified. analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines Oropouche virus (OROV), an emerging arbovirus in the Orthobunyavirus genus (Peribunyaviridae), focusing on its evolution, epidemiology, pathophysiology, and vaccine development as a public health concern in Central and South America and newly affected regions. The central question addresses the virus's transmission dynamics, clinical spectrum, diagnostic challenges, and prevention strategies.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is narrative in scope and does not explicitly report databases, search dates, eligibility criteria, or selection methods. It synthesizes evidence on OROV without conducting a systematic review or meta-analysis, relying on general sources and reported case data.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: OROV exhibits complex transmission cycles involving Culicoides paraensis as the primary vector, with alternative vectors such as Culex quinquefasciatus and Aedes serratus identified. Clinical manifestations range from acute febrile illness with biphasic fever in approximately 60% of cases to severe complications including haemorrhagic symptoms and neurological sequelae such as meningitis, encephalitis, and Guillain-Barre syndrome. Pathogenesis involves modulation of host innate immunity, particularly interferon responses, and the virus demonstrates neuroinvasive potential.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights diagnostic challenges due to non-specific clinical signs and limited access to specialized laboratory tests, contributing to substantial underreporting of cases. Evidence of vertical transmission raises concerns about fetal microcephaly, stillbirths, and congenital malformations, but the mechanisms and extent remain insufficiently characterized. The role of alternative vectors and reassortment-driven evolution in transmission dynamics requires further investigation.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Priority research areas include elucidating vertical transmission mechanisms and congenital outcomes, improving diagnostic tools for rapid and accurate detection, and characterizing the role of alternative vectors in transmission. Surveillance should expand to include newly affected regions and high-risk populations, particularly pregnant individuals. Vaccine development efforts should accelerate preclinical and clinical evaluation of promising candidates, including live-attenuated, inactivated, and recombinant protein-based platforms.

analysis.summary_en: This review synthesizes current knowledge on Oropouche virus (OROV), an emerging arbovirus causing significant public health concern in Central and South America and newly affected regions. OROV is primarily transmitted by Culicoides paraensis, with alternative vectors identified, and exhibits complex urban and sylvatic transmission cycles. Clinical presentations range from acute febrile illness to severe neurological and haemorrhagic complications. Pathogenesis involves modulation of host interferon responses and neuroinvasive potential. Diagnostic challenges and substantial underreporting persist due to non-specific symptoms and limited laboratory access. No specific treatments or vaccines are available, though several candidates are in preclinical and clinical evaluation. Key gaps include insufficient understanding of vertical transmission, congenital outcomes, and the role of alternative vectors. Research priorities include improving diagnostics, expanding surveillance, and accelerating vaccine development.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述研究了奥罗普切病毒(OROV),这是一种属于正布尼亚病毒属(Peribunyaviridae)的新兴虫媒病毒,重点关注其进化、流行病学、病理生理学和疫苗开发,作为中美洲和南美洲以及新受影响地区的公共卫生问题。核心问题涉及病毒的传播动力学、临床谱、诊断挑战和预防策略。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查在范围上是叙述性的,没有明确报告数据库、检索日期、资格标准或选择方法。它根据一般来源和报告的病例数据综合了 OROV 的证据,但没有进行系统评价或荟萃分析。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: OROV 表现出复杂的传播周期,以帕拉库蠓为主要媒介,同时还发现了致倦库蚊和锯齿伊蚊等替代媒介。临床表现包括约 60% 的病例出现双相发热的急性发热性疾病,以及包括出血症状和脑膜炎、脑炎和格林-巴利综合征等神经系统后遗症在内的严重并发症。发病机制涉及宿主先天免疫的调节,特别是干扰素反应,并且该病毒表现出神经侵袭潜力。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查强调了由于非特异性临床症状和获得专门实验室检测的机会有限而导致的诊断挑战,导致病例大量漏报。垂直传播的证据引起了人们对胎儿小头畸形、死产和先天畸形的担忧,但其机制和程度仍不充分。替代载体和重配驱动的进化在传播动力学中的作用需要进一步研究。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 优先研究领域包括阐明垂直传播机制和先天性后果,改进快速准确检测的诊断工具,以及表征替代媒介在传播中的作用。监测范围应扩大到新受影响地区和高危人群,特别是孕妇。疫苗开发工作应加快对有希望的候选疫苗的临床前和临床评估,包括减毒活疫苗、灭活疫苗和基于重组蛋白的平台。

papers.title: Habitat Type and Seasonal Variation as Drivers of Mosquito Proliferation in Urban Aquatic Microhabitats
papers.abstract: Abstract Aedes aegypti is the primary vector species for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya viruses, and is adapted to thrive in urban environments. Their proximity to human populations and the adverse health outcomes associated with arboviral infections make mosquito control essential for reducing the risk of outbreaks and disease spread. Source reduction and larvicide applications are central components of mosquito control because they reduce adult mosquito emergence by targeting immature life stages. Therefore, our objective was to identify urban aquatic habitats used by Ae. aegypti and assess temporal variation in their contribution to immature mosquito production. To distinguish habitat use from habitat productivity, we considered larval presence as an indicator of oviposition or early-stage survival and pupal presence as evidence that a habitat supported development through most of the immature life cycle. Between July 2018 and October 2019, 2,482 inspections in Miami-Dade County, Florida, identified 2,756 aquatic habitats from which 19,466 Ae. aegypti larvae and 3,648 pupae were collected. Unique temporal trends were observed for both larval and pupal presence and abundance at county and habitat resolutions. County-level trends showed the highest larval and pupal production during Summer and the lowest pupal production during Winter. However, temporal patterns differed across habitats, supporting a context-dependent interpretation of habitat conduciveness, in which the same habitat type may support different levels of immature mosquito production depending on local environmental conditions. Our results show that habitats with frequent larval occurrence did not consistently have high pupal presence, indicating that larval presence does not necessarily reflect habitat productivity. Control strategies that prioritize habitats repeatedly associated with pupal production by season may improve year-round mosquito control, outbreak preparedness, and resource allocation.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 埃及伊蚊是登革热、寨卡病毒和基孔肯雅病毒的主要媒介物种,适合在城市环境中繁衍生息。由于蚊子与人群的距离很近,并且与虫媒病毒感染相关的不良健康后果,因此控制蚊子对于降低疫情和疾病传播的风险至关重要。减少源头和杀幼虫剂的应用是蚊子控制的核心组成部分,因为它们通过针对未成熟的生命阶段来减少成蚊的出现。因此,我们的目标是确定伊蚊使用的城市水生栖息地。埃及伊蚊并评估其对未成熟蚊子生产的贡献的时间变化。为了区分栖息地利用和栖息地生产力,我们将幼虫的存在视为产卵或早期生存的指标,将蛹的存在视为栖息地在大部分未成熟生命周期中支持发育的证据。2018 年 7 月至 2019 年 10 月期间,佛罗里达州迈阿密戴德县进行了 2,482 次检查,发现了 2,756 个水生栖息地,其中 19,466 种白斑蚊。收集了埃及伊蚊幼虫和 3,648 只蛹。在县和栖息地分辨率下,观察到幼虫和蛹的存在和丰度的独特时间趋势。县级趋势显示,夏季幼虫和蛹产量最高,冬季蛹产量最低。然而,不同栖息地的时间模式不同,支持对栖息地有利性的上下文相关解释,其中相同的栖息地类型可能根据当地环境条件支持不同水平的未成熟蚊子生产。我们的结果表明,幼虫频繁出现的栖息地并不总是有大量的蛹存在,这表明幼虫的存在并不一定反映栖息地的生产力。按季节优先考虑与蛹生产相关的栖息地的控制策略可能会改善全年的蚊子控制、疫情爆发准备和资源分配。

papers.title: Insecticide resistance in mosquitoes: Current status, mechanism, monitoring and innovative strategies for sustainable vector control.
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne diseases such as malaria, dengue, chikungunya, Zika and yellow fever remain major public health challenges worldwide, causing millions of cases and thousands of deaths annually. Vector control has been the cornerstone of prevention strategies, with insecticides being the most commonly used intervention. However, the widespread and often indiscriminate use of insecticides has led to the emergence of insecticide resistance in the mosquito population, thereby threatening the sustainability of existing control measures. This review presents the current status of insecticide resistance, its underlying mechanisms, and global trends in resistance. The alternative vector control strategies, such as genetic modification, Wolbachia-based methods, botanical insecticides and nanotechnology-driven control measures, are also highlighted. It also explores the significance of insecticide resistance monitoring, integrated resistance management strategies and the need for new compounds with a distinct mode of action to ensure the continued effectiveness of vector control.

papers.title_zh: 蚊子的杀虫剂抗药性:可持续病媒控制的现状、机制、监测和创新策略。
papers.source_body_en: Mosquito-borne diseases such as malaria, dengue, chikungunya, Zika and yellow fever remain major public health challenges worldwide, causing millions of cases and thousands of deaths annually. Vector control has been the cornerstone of prevention strategies, with insecticides being the most commonly used intervention. However, the widespread and often indiscriminate use of insecticides has led to the emergence of insecticide resistance in the mosquito population, thereby threatening the sustainability of existing control measures. This review presents the current status of insecticide resistance, its underlying mechanisms, and global trends in resistance. The alternative vector control strategies, such as genetic modification, Wolbachia-based methods, botanical insecticides and nanotechnology-driven control measures, are also highlighted. It also explores the significance of insecticide resistance monitoring, integrated resistance management strategies and the need for new compounds with a distinct mode of action to ensure the continued effectiveness of vector control.
papers.abstract_zh: 疟疾、登革热、基孔肯雅热、寨卡病毒和黄热病等蚊媒疾病仍然是全世界主要的公共卫生挑战,每年造成数百万例病例和数千人死亡。病媒控制一直是预防策略的基石,其中杀虫剂是最常用的干预措施。然而,杀虫剂的广泛且往往不加区别的使用导致蚊子种群出现杀虫剂抗药性,从而威胁到现有控制措施的可持续性。本综述介绍了杀虫剂耐药性的现状、其潜在机制以及全球耐药性趋势。还强调了替代病媒控制策略,例如基因改造、基于沃尔巴克氏体的方法、植物杀虫剂和纳米技术驱动的控制措施。它还探讨了杀虫剂抗性监测、综合抗性管理策略的重要性,以及对具有独特作用模式的新化合物的需求,以确保病媒控制的持续有效性。

papers.title: Gut microbe-derived short-chain fatty acids regulate alphavirus arthritis and macrophage activation in mice.
papers.abstract: Oral antibiotics can predispose to joint inflammation, but this phenomenon remains poorly understood. Here, we leverage mouse models of alphavirus-induced arthritis to investigate the roles of gut commensals, metabolites, and host immune mechanisms in promoting musculoskeletal inflammation. Mice treated with a short course of oral antibiotics exhibited worsened arthritis after chikungunya (CHIKV) or Mayaro virus infections. This phenotype was associated with loss of short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), greater intestinal permeability, and activation of gut-associated immune cells and required TLR4 signaling, MyD88 expression, monocytes, antigen-specific and bystander CD4+ T cells, and proinflammatory cytokines. Administration of exogenous SCFAs or colonization of mice with bacterial species that generate SCFAs mitigated CHIKV-induced joint inflammation. scRNA-seq revealed that gut-derived SCFAs ameliorate the inflammatory phenotype of synovial CD4+ T cells, infiltrating monocytes, and resident osteoclast-like cells. Thus, antibiotic-triggered gut dysbiosis exacerbates alphavirus arthritis by shaping the inflammatory profile of both infiltrating and resident immune cells in joint tissues.

papers.title: Identification of Direct-Acting nsP2 Helicase Inhibitors with Antialphaviral Activity.
papers.abstract: Alphaviruses are mosquito-borne RNA viruses that pose a significant public health threat, with no FDA-approved antiviral therapeutics available. The nonstructural protein 2 helicase (nsP2hel) is an enzyme involved in unwinding dsRNA essential for alphavirus replication. This study reports the discovery and optimization of first-in-class oxaspiropiperidine inhibitors targeting nsP2hel. Structure-activity relationship (SAR) studies identified potent cyclic sulfonamide analogs with nanomolar antiviral activity against chikungunya virus (CHIKV). Biochemical analyses of nsP2hel ATPase and RNA unwindase activities showed these compounds act in a noncompetitive mode, suggesting that they are allosteric inhibitors. Viral resistance mutations mapped to nsP2hel and a fluorine-labeled analog exhibited direct binding to the protein by 19 F NMR. The lead inhibitor, 2o , demonstrated broad-spectrum antialphaviral activity, reducing titers of CHIKV, Mayaro virus (MAYV), and Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus (VEEV). These findings support nsP2hel as a viable target for the development of broad-spectrum, direct-acting antialphaviral drugs.

papers.title: Evaluation of Escherichia coli-derived Silver Nanoparticles for Aedes Vector Control in Southern India.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus are the principal mosquito vectors in Tamil Nadu transmitting the major arboviral diseases such as Dengue, Chikungunya, Zika and Yellow Fever. Aedes aegypti serves as the primary vector, followed by Aedes albopictus. Due to the limitations and environmental concerns associated with predictable chemical larvicides, there is an emergency need for alternative and sustainable vector control strategies. METHODS: In this study, environmentally friendly silver nanoparticles were synthesized using Escherichia coli through a biogenic approach that develops the bacterium's naturally reducing and stabilizing properties. The synthesized silver nanoparticles were characterized for size, shape, and stability using UV-Visible spectroscopy and Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy. The larvicidal efficacy of silver nanoparticles was evaluated against the larvae of Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus from the Thiruvarur district of Tamil Nadu, India. LC50 and LC90 values were estimated using probit analysis according to Finney's method (Miller-Tainter approach) in SPSS. RESULTS: The biosynthesized silver nanoparticles showed strong larvicidal activity against both mosquito species, depending on the dose approach, the moderate larval mortality was observed in Aedes albopictus than in Aedes aegypti. The median lethal concentration (LC50) was estimated at 270 ± 16 mg/L for Aedes aegypti and 194 ± 13 mg/L for Aedes albopictus, and LC90 values were estimated at 3480 ± 490 mg/L for Aedes aegypti and 2510 ± 360 mg/L for Aedes albopictus. The findings indicate that the biogenically synthesized silver nanoparticles are an effective alternative to chemical larvicides, offering enhanced efficacy with reduced environment impact. CONCLUSION: The current study highlights the dual advantages of utilizing biological resources for nanoparticle synthesis and implementing sustainable approaches for the control of mosquito- borne diseases. Future research should focus on large-scale production, field-level efficacy assessments, and evaluation of potential effects on non-target organisms to support practical applications.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊是泰米尔纳德邦传播登革热、基孔肯雅热、寨卡病毒和黄热病等主要虫媒病毒疾病的主要蚊媒。埃及伊蚊是主要媒介,其次是白纹伊蚊。由于可预测的化学杀幼虫剂的局限性和环境问题,迫切需要替代和可持续的病媒控制策略。方法:在这项研究中,利用大肠杆菌通过生物方法合成了环保型银纳米颗粒,该方法开发了细菌的自然还原和稳定特性。使用紫外-可见光谱和傅里叶变换红外(FTIR)光谱对合成的银纳米颗粒的尺寸、形状和稳定性进行了表征。针对印度泰米尔纳德邦蒂鲁瓦鲁尔地区的埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊幼虫,评估了银纳米粒子的杀幼虫功效。LC50和LC90值是根据SPSS中的芬尼法(Miller-Tainter法)使用概率分析来估计的。结果:生物合成的银纳米粒子对两种蚊子均表现出很强的杀幼虫活性,根据剂量方法,白纹伊蚊的幼虫死亡率低于埃及伊蚊。埃及伊蚊的半致死浓度 (LC50) 估计为 270 ± 16 mg/L,白纹伊蚊的半致死浓度 (LC50) 估计为 194 ± 13 mg/L,埃及伊蚊的半致死浓度 (LC90) 估计为 3480 ± 490 mg/L,白纹伊蚊的 LC90 值估计为 2510 ± 360 mg/L。研究结果表明,生物合成的银纳米颗粒是化学杀幼虫剂的有效替代品,可提高功效并减少对环境的影响。结论:当前的研究强调了利用生物资源合成纳米颗粒和实施可持续方法控制蚊媒疾病的双重优势。未来的研究应侧重于大规模生产、现场功效评估以及对非目标生物体的潜在影响的评估,以支持实际应用。

papers.title: Integrated surveillance of arboviruses in febrile patients from the Brazilian Amazon reveals complex co-circulation dynamics and hidden viral diversity
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background: Arboviral infections continue to be a significant public health challenge in the Brazilian Amazon. Overlapping symptoms, limited laboratory access, and the circulation of multiple arboviruses hamper clinical diagnosis. This study aimed to characterize the epidemiological, clinical, laboratory and genomic profiles of arboviral infections in febrile patients in Manaus, Brazil, and explore additional viral agents using metagenomic sequencing. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted between February 2021 and February 2023 at a tertiary reference center in Manaus, Brazil. Patients aged ≥ 5 years of age presenting with a rash and either a fever or a history of fever lasting <7 days and a negative thick blood smear for malaria were enrolled. Serum samples were tested for dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), yellow fever virus (YF), Oropouche virus (OROV), and Mayaro virus (MAYV) using ELISA and RT-qPCR. Positive samples were subjected to amplicon-based genome sequencing for phylogenetic analysis. A subset of RT-qPCR negative samples was analyzed using de novo shotgun metagenomic sequencing. Results: Among the 708 enrolled participants, 243 (34.3%) had a laboratory-confirmed arboviral infection: 92 (37.9%) DENV, 64 (26.3%) CHIKV, and 4 (1.6%) ZIKV, while 83 (34.2%) laboratory profiles were compatible with coinfection, predominantly DENV+CHIKV (55/83; 66.3%). Circulation of DENV-1 genotype V and DENV-2 genotypes III (Asian American) and II (Cosmopolitan) was identified. Metagenomic analysis of 35 samples detected Pegivirus hominis and Erythroparvovirus primate 1. Conclusions: These findings demonstrate complex arbovirus co-circulation in Manaus and support integrated surveillance strategies combining molecular, serological, and genomic approaches.
papers.journal: Revista da Sociedade Brasileira de Medicina Tropical

analysis.research_question_and_background: Arboviral infections pose a persistent public health burden in the Brazilian Amazon due to overlapping clinical presentations, limited diagnostic capacity, and co-circulation of multiple viruses. The study addressed the need to characterize arboviral infections in febrile patients in Manaus, Brazil, where diagnostic challenges hinder accurate identification.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted from February 2021 to February 2023 at a tertiary reference center in Manaus, Brazil. Patients aged 5 years or older with fever or recent fever history, rash, and a negative thick blood smear for malaria were enrolled. The study included 708 participants.
analysis.methods: Serum samples were tested for DENV, ZIKV, CHIKV, YF, OROV, and MAYV using ELISA and RT-qPCR. Positive samples underwent amplicon-based genome sequencing for phylogenetic analysis. A subset of RT-qPCR-negative samples was analyzed using de novo shotgun metagenomic sequencing.
analysis.main_results: Among 708 participants, 243 (34.3%) had laboratory-confirmed arboviral infections: 92 (37.9%) DENV, 64 (26.3%) CHIKV, and 4 (1.6%) ZIKV. Coinfections were detected in 83 (34.2%) cases, predominantly DENV+CHIKV (55/83; 66.3%). DENV-1 genotype V and DENV-2 genotypes III and II were identified. Metagenomic analysis of 35 samples detected Pegivirus hominis and Erythroparvovirus primate 1.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrates complex co-circulation of arboviruses in Manaus, including previously underappreciated viral diversity and coinfections. It highlights the utility of integrated surveillance combining molecular, serological, and genomic approaches to improve diagnostic accuracy.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the implementation of integrated arbovirus surveillance systems in endemic regions to enhance early detection, guide clinical management, and inform public health interventions in settings with limited laboratory resources.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, single-center setting, and reliance on RT-qPCR and ELISA for initial testing, which may underestimate viral diversity. The evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of longitudinal follow-up and potential selection bias in metagenomic sampling.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study in Manaus, Brazil, enrolled 708 febrile patients with rash and negative malaria smears between 2021 and 2023 to characterize arboviral infections. Using ELISA, RT-qPCR, and metagenomic sequencing, 34.3% of participants had confirmed arboviral infections, including DENV, CHIKV, and ZIKV, with 34.2% showing coinfections, predominantly DENV+CHIKV. Phylogenetic analysis identified DENV-1 genotype V and DENV-2 genotypes III and II, while metagenomics detected Pegivirus hominis and Erythroparvovirus primate 1 in a subset of samples. The study underscores the complexity of arbovirus co-circulation and supports integrated surveillance strategies combining molecular, serological, and genomic methods to improve diagnostic precision in resource-limited settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于重叠的临床表现、有限的诊断能力以及多种病毒的共同传播,虫媒病毒感染对巴西亚马逊地区造成了持续的公共卫生负担。该研究解决了巴西马瑙斯发热患者虫媒病毒感染特征的需要,该地区的诊断挑战阻碍了准确识别。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2021 年 2 月至 2023 年 2 月在巴西马瑙斯的一个三级参考中心进行了一项横断面研究。纳入年龄为 5 岁或以上、有发烧或近期发烧史、皮疹和疟疾厚血涂片阴性的患者。该研究共有 708 名参与者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 ELISA 和 RT-qPCR 对血清样本进行 DENV、ZIKV、CHIKV、YF、OROV 和 MAYV 检测。对阳性样本进行基于扩增子的基因组测序以进行系统发育分析。使用从头鸟枪法宏基因组测序分析了 RT-qPCR 阴性样本的子集。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 708 名参与者中,243 名(34.3%)人患有实验室确诊的虫媒病毒感染:92 名(37.9%)DENV、64 名(26.3%)CHIKV 和 4 名(1.6%)ZIKV。在 83 例 (34.2%) 病例中检测到混合感染,主要是 DENV+CHIKV (55/83;66.3%)。鉴定出 DENV-1 基因型 V 和 DENV-2 基因型 III 和 II。对 35 个样本的宏基因组分析检测到人型佩吉病毒和灵长类红细小病毒 1。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明马瑙斯虫媒病毒存在复杂的共同循环,包括以前未被充分认识的病毒多样性和共同感染。它强调了结合分子、血清学和基因组方法的综合监测在提高诊断准确性方面的实用性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持在流行地区实施综合虫媒病毒监测系统,以加强早期发现,指导临床管理,并为实验室资源有限的环境中的公共卫生干预措施提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计、单中心设置以及依赖 RT-qPCR 和 ELISA 进行初步测试的限制,这可能会低估病毒多样性。由于缺乏纵向随访和宏基因组采样中潜在的选择偏差,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要背景:虫媒病毒感染仍然是巴西亚马逊地区的一个重大公共卫生挑战。重叠的症状、有限的实验室访问以及多种虫媒病毒的传播阻碍了临床诊断。本研究旨在描述巴西马瑙斯发热患者虫媒病毒感染的流行病学、临床、实验室和基因组特征,并利用宏基因组测序探索其他病毒因子。方法:2021 年 2 月至 2023 年 2 月在巴西马瑙斯的一个三级参考中心进行了一项横断面研究。年龄≥5岁、出现皮疹、发烧或发烧史持续<7天且疟疾厚血涂片呈阴性的患者被纳入研究。使用 ELISA 和 RT-qPCR 检测血清样本中的登革热病毒 (DENV)、寨卡病毒 (ZIKV)、基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV)、黄热病病毒 (YF)、奥罗普切病毒 (OROV) 和马亚罗病毒 (MAYV)。对阳性样本进行基于扩增子的基因组测序以进行系统发育分析。使用从头鸟枪宏基因组测序分析 RT-qPCR 阴性样本的子集。结果:在 708 名入组参与者中,243 名(34.3%)有实验室确诊的虫媒病毒感染:92 名(37.9%)DENV、64 名(26.3%)CHIKV 和 4 名(1.6%)ZIKV,而 83 名(34.2%)实验室资料符合双重感染,主要是 DENV+CHIKV(55/83;66.3%)。确定了 DENV-1 基因型 V 和 DENV-2 基因型 III(亚裔美国人)和 II(国际大都会)的循环。对 35 个样本的宏基因组分析检测到人型佩吉病毒和灵长类红细小病毒 1. 结论:这些发现表明马瑙斯存在复杂的虫媒病毒共循环,并支持结合分子、血清学和基因组方法的综合监测策略。
papers.summary_zh: 摘要背景:虫媒病毒感染仍然是巴西亚马逊地区的一个重大公共卫生挑战。重叠的症状、有限的实验室访问以及多种虫媒病毒的传播阻碍了临床诊断。本研究旨在描述巴西马瑙斯发热患者虫媒病毒感染的流行病学、临床、实验室和基因组特征,并利用宏基因组测序探索其他病毒因子。方法:2021 年 2 月至 2023 年 2 月在巴西马瑙斯的一个三级参考中心进行了一项横断面研究。年龄≥5岁、出现皮疹、发烧或发烧史持续<7天且疟疾厚血涂片呈阴性的患者被纳入研究。使用 ELISA 和 RT-qPCR 检测血清样本中的登革热病毒 (DENV)、寨卡病毒 (ZIKV)、基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV)、黄热病病毒 (YF)、奥罗普切病毒 (OROV) 和马亚罗病毒 (MAYV)。对阳性样本进行基于扩增子的基因组测序以进行系统发育分析。使用从头鸟枪宏基因组测序分析 RT-qPCR 阴性样本的子集。结果:在 708 名入组参与者中,243 名(34.3%)有实验室确诊的虫媒病毒感染:92 名(37.9%)DENV、64 名(26.3%)CHIKV 和 4 名(1.6%)ZIKV,而 83 名(34.2%)实验室资料符合双重感染,主要是 DENV+CHIKV(55/83;66.3%)。确定了 DENV-1 基因型 V 和 DENV-2 基因型 III(亚裔美国人)和 II(国际大都会)的循环。对 35 个样本的宏基因组分析检测到人型佩吉病毒和灵长类红细小病毒 1. 结论:这些发现表明马瑙斯存在复杂的虫媒病毒共循环,并支持结合分子、血清学和基因组方法的综合监测策略。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于重叠的临床表现、有限的诊断能力以及多种病毒的共同传播,虫媒病毒感染对巴西亚马逊地区造成了持续的公共卫生负担。该研究解决了巴西马瑙斯发热患者虫媒病毒感染特征的需要,该地区的诊断挑战阻碍了准确识别。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2021 年 2 月至 2023 年 2 月在巴西马瑙斯的一个三级参考中心进行了一项横断面研究。纳入年龄为 5 岁或以上、有发烧或近期发烧史、皮疹和疟疾厚血涂片阴性的患者。该研究共有 708 名参与者。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用 ELISA 和 RT-qPCR 对血清样本进行 DENV、ZIKV、CHIKV、YF、OROV 和 MAYV 检测。对阳性样本进行基于扩增子的基因组测序以进行系统发育分析。使用从头鸟枪法宏基因组测序分析了 RT-qPCR 阴性样本的子集。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在 708 名参与者中,243 名(34.3%)人患有实验室确诊的虫媒病毒感染:92 名(37.9%)DENV、64 名(26.3%)CHIKV 和 4 名(1.6%)ZIKV。在 83 例 (34.2%) 病例中检测到混合感染,主要是 DENV+CHIKV (55/83;66.3%)。鉴定出 DENV-1 基因型 V 和 DENV-2 基因型 III 和 II。对 35 个样本的宏基因组分析检测到人型佩吉病毒和灵长类红细小病毒 1。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明马瑙斯虫媒病毒存在复杂的共同循环,包括以前未被充分认识的病毒多样性和共同感染。它强调了结合分子、血清学和基因组方法的综合监测在提高诊断准确性方面的实用性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持在流行地区实施综合虫媒病毒监测系统,以加强早期发现,指导临床管理,并为实验室资源有限的环境中的公共卫生干预措施提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计、单中心设置以及依赖 RT-qPCR 和 ELISA 进行初步测试的限制,这可能会低估病毒多样性。由于缺乏纵向随访和宏基因组采样中潜在的选择偏差,证据强度中等。

U.S. travelers can use this information on chikungunya risk to help with decisions on vaccination. Some U.S. travelers (e.g., pregnant women) can use this information on chikungunya risk to help decide if they should avoid travel. Background Chikungunya cases and outbreaks have been identified in more than 100 countries in the past. Chikungunya virus circulates in tropical and subtropical regions. Surveillance and laboratory testing practices for chikungunya vary greatly among countries. CDC does not always have information on the current risk in all geographic locations. Current outbreaks There is a chikungunya travel health notice for outbreaks in: Bolivia (Santa Cruz and Cochabamba Departments) Costa Rica (Playa Langosta and northwest Pacific coastal areas) French Guiana Mauritius Mayotte Seychelles Suriname Vaccine recommendations Vaccination is recommended for travelers visiting an area with an outbreak. Learn more about available vaccines, recommendations, and considerations.Chikungunya Vaccines CDC prioritizes posting information on outbreaks that might impact U.S. travelers so they can make informed decisions about their risk of exposure to chikungunya virus. Many factors are considered before CDC posts outbreak notices, including: Evidence of laboratory-confirmed disease among residents or travelers The number of people sick with the disease compared with historical levels The time of year when the cases are being reported relative to the known mosquito season in a location An increase in cases among U.S. travelers Geographic extent or size of an outbreak Transmission in a new area or an area that has not had disease cases for an extended time, which increases the risk of people getting sick and spreading the virus to uninfected mosquitoes that then bite other people Level of concern for U.S. travelers based on the typical volume of U.S. travelers to the destination Countries with elevated risk for U.S. travelers U.S. travelers visiting the following countries are at elevated risk* of exposure to chikungunya virus, even if there is no current outbreak: Brazil Colombia India Indonesia Mexico Nigeria Pakistan Peru Philippines Thailand *Countries in this list have had a median of one or more cases reported annually in U.S. travelers during the last 5 years, with at least one case that was laboratory-confirmed. Vaccine considerations Vaccination may be considered for travelers visiting or moving to an area without an outbreak but with elevated risk for U.S. travelers if planning to stay for an extended period of time. Learn more about available vaccines and considerations for their use.Chikungunya Vaccines Cases in the United States The most recent locally acquired case was reported from a U.S. state in 2025. analysis.brief_en: On July 16, 2026, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) published an updated resource detailing areas at risk for chikungunya, primarily targeting U.S. travelers. The guidance identifies specific countries with current travel health notices, including Bolivia, Costa Rica, French Guiana, Mauritius, Mayotte, Seychelles, and Suriname. Additionally, it lists ten countries—Brazil, Colombia, India, Indonesia, Mexico, Nigeria, Pakistan, Peru, the Philippines, and Thailand—as having elevated risk for U.S. travelers, even in the absence of a current outbreak. The CDC notes that chikungunya historically circulates in tropical and subtropical regions and that surveillance practices vary globally. The resource emphasizes that vaccination may be recommended for travelers visiting outbreak areas and considered for those in elevated-risk regions planning extended stays. It also highlights that the most recent locally acquired case in the U.S. was reported on the same date.

analysis_en.scale_impact_and_risk: Historical context: chikungunya cases and outbreaks identified in over 100 countries. Current risk: travel health notices issued for specific regions. Elevated risk countries have reported a median of one or more cases annually in U.S. travelers over the last 5 years, with at least one laboratory-confirmed case. The risk is defined by the presence of outbreaks or elevated risk levels for U.S.
analysis_en.response_status_and_uncertainty: CDC provides risk maps and travel notices. Surveillance and laboratory testing practices vary greatly among countries. CDC does not always have information on current risk in all geographic locations. The guidance is for public health awareness and travel decision-making.

news.source_body_en: On July 16, 2026, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) published an updated resource detailing areas at risk for chikungunya, primarily targeting U.S. travelers. The guidance identifies specific countries with current travel health notices, including Bolivia, Costa Rica, French Guiana, Mauritius, Mayotte, Seychelles, and Suriname. Additionally, it lists ten countries—Brazil, Colombia, India, Indonesia, Mexico, Nigeria, Pakistan, Peru, the Philippines, and Thailand—as having elevated risk for U.S. travelers, even in the absence of a current outbreak. The CDC notes that chikungunya historically circulates in tropical and subtropical regions and that surveillance practices vary globally. The resource emphasizes that vaccination may be recommended for travelers visiting outbreak areas and considered for those in elevated-risk regions planning extended stays. It also highlights that the most recent locally acquired case in the U.S. was reported on the same date.

Chikungunya Virus Explore This Topic Search Search Clear Search For Everyone About Symptoms Causes and Spread Vaccines Prevention Areas at Risk View all Health Care Providers Clinical Signs and Symptoms Vaccine Product Information Clinical Testing and Diagnosis Treatment and Prevention View all Public Health Resources Mosquito Control View all search clear search Chikungunya Virus Menu clear search For Everyone About Symptoms Causes and Spread Vaccines Prevention Areas at Risk View All Health Care Providers Clinical Signs and Symptoms Vaccine Product Information Clinical Testing and Diagnosis Treatment and Prevention View All Public Health Resources Mosquito Control View All Related Topics Vector-Borne Diseases About Symptoms Causes and Spread Vaccines Prevention Areas at Risk View Menu Chikungunya: Causes and How It Spreads For Everyone July 15, 2026 Key points Chikungunya virus disease (chikungunya) is caused by a virus primarily spread to people through the bite of infected mosquitoes. If infected, people can spread the virus to uninfected mosquitoes and rarely to other people. The risk of a person spreading the virus is highest during the first week of illness. Primary cause Chikungunya is caused by a virus that can be found in many parts of the world, including tropical and subtropical regions of Africa, the Americas, Asia, Europe, and islands in the Indian and Pacific Oceans. About the virus Chikungunya virus belongs to the family Togaviridae, genus Alphavirus. Chikungunya virus particles are enveloped icosahedral capsids and have a diameter of 60–70 nm. Alphavirus infections can either cause arthralgic (causing joint pain) or neuroinvasive disease (affecting the central nervous system). Other medically important alphaviruses found in the Americas include eastern equine encephalitis virus (neuroinvasive), Mayaro virus (arthralgic), and western equine encephalitis virus (neuroinvasive). Electron microscopic image of chikungunya virus. How it spreads People can become infected with chikungunya virus when mosquitoes feed on another infected person and then bite them. People infected with chikungunya virus have high enough levels of virus in their blood (viremia) during the first week of illness to transmit the virus to mosquitoes. Risk of further spread of chikungunya virus increases if people with viremia are bitten by uninfected mosquitoes. Because of the high level of virus in blood, spread can also occur through: Blood transfusion (probable) Exposure to the virus in the laboratory The virus does not spread from person to person through coughing, sneezing, or touching. Pregnancy and breastfeeding Rarely, the infection can spread from a pregnant woman to her fetus (in utero transmission). If the pregnant woman is infected around the time of delivery, the baby can be infected at birth (intrapartum transmission), often resulting in severe disease in the baby. Chikungunya virus has not been found in breast milk, and there have been no reports to date of infants being infected through breastfeeding. Talk to your doctor if you are breastfeeding and have chikungunya or if you are in an area where the virus is circulating. Because the benefits of breastfeeding likely outweigh the risk of spreading the virus through breastfeeding, mothers should continue to breastfeed even if they are infected with chikungunya virus or live in an area with ongoing virus transmission. Prevent chikungunya The best way to protect yourself is to prevent mosquito bites. Vaccination is recommended for some travelers. Transmission cycle Chikungunya virus is primarily transmitted to people through the bite of an infected mosquito, mainly Aedes aegypti and Ae. albopictus. People are the primary hosts of chikungunya virus during epidemic periods. Mosquitoes become infected when they feed on a person who already has the virus. Person-to-person transmission via in utero and intrapartum routes has been documented. It is likely the virus can also be transmitted via blood transfusions. View LargerDownload Chikungunya virus cycles through Aedes species mosquitoes and people during epidemic periods. elements_zh.time: 基孔肯雅病毒 探索此主题 搜索 搜索 清除搜索 适合所有人 关于症状、原因和传播 疫苗预防领域 有风险 查看所有医疗保健提供者 临床体征和症状 疫苗产品信息 临床测试和诊断 治疗和预防 查看所有公共卫生资源 蚊子控制 查看所有搜索 清除搜索 基孔肯雅病毒菜单 清除搜索 适合所有人 关于症状、原因和传播 疫苗预防领域 有风险 查看所有医疗保健提供者 临床体征和症状 疫苗产品信息 临床检测和诊断 治疗和预防 查看所有公共卫生资源 蚊子控制 查看所有相关主题 媒介传播疾病 关于症状 原因和传播 疫苗预防 面临风险的区域 查看菜单 基孔肯雅热:原因及其如何在每个人中传播 2026 年 7 月 15 日 要点 基孔肯雅病毒病 (基孔肯雅热) 是由主要通过受感染蚊子叮咬传播给人类的病毒引起的。
elements_zh.location_and_population: 主要原因 基孔肯雅热是由一种病毒引起的,这种病毒可以在世界许多地方发现,包括非洲的热带和亚热带地区、美洲、亚洲、欧洲以及印度洋和太平洋的岛屿。
elements_zh.event: 由于血液中病毒含量较高,传播也可能通过以下方式发生: 输血(可能) 在实验室中接触病毒 病毒不会通过咳嗽、打喷嚏或触摸在人与人之间传播。
elements_zh.scale_impact_and_risk: 如果孕妇在分娩时被感染,婴儿可能在出生时被感染(产时传播),常常导致婴儿患严重疾病。
elements_zh.response_status_and_uncertainty: 建议部分旅客接种疫苗。

By redesigning nucleic acid amplification products to create multiple bridging sites and pairing this strategy with gold@platinum nanoparticle-based colorimetric enhancement, the method achieved a visual detection limit as low as 2 pmol·L−1 for CHIKV. The work offers a promising diagnostic platform for rapid field testing, outbreak surveillance, and infection control, especially in resource-limited regions where conventional laboratory instruments are difficult to access.Mosquito-borne viruses, including CHIKV, Dengue virus, Zika virus, Yellow fever virus, Japanese encephalitis virus, West Nile virus, and Getah virus, continue to pose growing threats to public health as international travel, trade, and climate-related vector expansion increase transmission risks. Nucleic acid testing provides high accuracy because it detects intrinsic viral gene sequences and can help distinguish viral variants. However, widely used methods such as reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), reverse transcription loop-mediated isothermal amplification, rolling circle amplification, and CRISPR-based assays often depend on enzymes, thermal cycling, fluorescence readers, or other specialized equipment. Existing catalytic hairpin assembly-based lateral flow assays have improved portability, but their sensitivity is limited by the small number of sites available for bridging colorimetric probes to the test line. These limitations highlight the need for a simpler, more sensitive, enzyme-free platform suitable for on-site viral detection.A study (DOI: 10.48130/targetome-0026-0016) published in Targetome on 30 April 2026 by Yanmin Ju's team, China Pharmaceutical University, reports an enzyme-free mbLFIA strategy that strengthens test-strip signals through multisite molecular bridging and Au@Pt nanoparticle-catalyzed color deposition.The researchers first designed a two-round catalytic hairpin assembly (CHA) system involving four hairpin probes, H1, H2, H3, and H4. When CHIKV target RNA is present, it triggers hybridization between H1 and H2, releasing the target to start additional amplification cycles. The resulting H1H2 complex then activates H3 and H4 to generate H3H4 hybridization products. Unlike conventional products with limited bridging sites, the H3H4 products were engineered with multiple equivalent binding sites, allowing them to connect Au@Pt-DNA probes to the test line through two bridging mechanisms. This design markedly increased the colorimetric signal: at low product concentration, the multisite structure produced a signal 10.8 times and 9.6 times stronger than two limited-site designs. The team then synthesized Au@Pt nanoparticles, confirmed their structure and composition using transmission electron microscopy, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, X-ray diffraction, and related analyses, and demonstrated their strong peroxidase-like catalytic activity. These nanoparticles catalyzed the oxidation of 3-amino-9-ethylcarbazole (AEC), forming an insoluble brown-red precipitate on the test line and further amplifying the visual readout. After optimizing reaction temperature, hairpin ratios, reaction time, probe volume, AEC concentration, hydrogen peroxide concentration, and enhancement time, the assay showed a visual detection range from 2 to 104 pmol·L−1 after colorimetric enhancement, compared with 20 to 104 pmol·L−1 for the general assay. Specificity tests showed that the CHIKV signal was significantly stronger than signals from ZIKV, DENV, WNV, YFV, JEV, and GETV. In spiked serum, saliva, and urine matrices, recovery rates remained within 80%–120%, indicating good tolerance to biological samples. Finally, in 36 suspected CHIKV mouse serum samples, mbLFIA identified 16 positives and 20 negatives, matching RT-PCR results with 100% concordance, sensitivity, and specificity.This study provides a new strategy for strengthening lateral flow assay signals by increasing the number and efficiency of molecular bridging events. By combining enzyme-free CHA amplification, multisite hybridization products, and nanozyme-assisted AEC deposition, the platform improves visual sensitivity without requiring complex instruments. The researchers suggest that mbLFIA could support rapid detection of mosquito-borne viruses in clinics, ports, field stations, and low-resource areas, and may be adapted for broader nucleic acid testing applications in infectious disease surveillance. Source:Chinese Academy of SciencesJournal reference:Nie, Y., et al. (2026). A multisite bridging mediated lateral flow immunoassay for the enhanced detection of mosquito-borne viruses. Targetome. analysis.brief_en: A research team has developed a novel diagnostic tool, the multisite bridging-mediated lateral flow immunoassay (mbLFIA), for the detection of mosquito-borne viruses. Using Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) as a model, the team achieved a highly sensitive and portable detection method with a visual limit as low as 2 pmol·L−1. The mbLFIA platform employs a two-round catalytic hairpin assembly system and gold@platinum nanoparticle-based colorimetric enhancement to amplify signals. The test demonstrated high specificity and sensitivity, matching RT-PCR results with 100% concordance in mouse serum samples. This innovative approach is particularly valuable for rapid field testing, outbreak surveillance, and infection control in resource-limited regions. The study, published in the journal Targetome on 30 April 2026, suggests that the mbLFIA platform could support rapid detection of mosquito-borne viruses in various settings and may be adapted for broader nucleic acid testing applications.

news.content_zh: 一个研究小组开发了一种新型诊断工具,即多位点桥接介导的侧流免疫分析(mbLFIA),用于检测蚊媒病毒。该团队以基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)为模型,实现了一种高灵敏度、便携式检测方法,视觉极限低至2 pmol·L−1。mbLFIA 平台采用两轮催化发夹组装系统和基于金@铂纳米颗粒的比色增强来放大信号。该测试表现出高特异性和敏感性,将 RT-PCR 结果与小鼠血清样本中的结果 100% 一致。这种创新方法对于资源有限地区的快速现场检测、疫情监测和感染控制特别有价值。该研究于 2026 年 4 月 30 日发表在《Targetome》杂志上,表明 mbLFIA 平台可以支持在各种环境下快速检测蚊媒病毒,并可能适用于更广泛的核酸检测应用。

news.content_title: U.S. Embassy Warns of Chikungunya Outbreak at Costa Rica's Playa Langosta
news.content: Whether it be secluded all-inclusive resorts like Secrets Papagayo , the surfer haven of Tamarindo, or Monteverde's mesmerizing cloud forests, travelers venture far and wide across the vast dreamscape of Costa Rica seeking to immerse themselves in the "Pura Vida" lifestyle. But that very reputation just took a ding as the U.S. Embassy is warning travelers of a concerning health alert . Typically, the tiny airport of Liberia, or the more common gateway of San Jose, are the best options to kickstart your Costa Rican adventure, where you can get up close and personal with an array of wildlife or kick back on a paradisal beach sipping your cocktail of choice. Those postcard-perfect plans spent seaside may deserve a second look, as one popular coastal community has been flagged following reports of a significant chikungunya outbreak — meaning mosquito repellent may become your new beach essential. No pun intended , but we got the deets ! Costa Rica's Ministry of Health Declares Playa Langosta Under Health Alert On July 1, the Ministry of Health had enough data to trigger an active outbreak of chikungunya — a disease carried by pesky mosquitoes that can leave people with high fevers, joint pain, headaches, swelling, nausea , and just simply feeling unwell. As of the Embassy's alert, it's being reported there have been 45 suspected cases affecting locals, and yes, tourists too. So far, "4 were confirmed and 17 were classified as probable." Playa Langosta lies adjacent to aforementioned Tamarindo, a huge draw for expats, surfers, and fellow Costa Ricans looking to escape the daily grind. It's not only the popularity of the Guanacaste region that's a growing concern; it's the fact that the virus is now circulating in the community's mosquito population, making DEET-based bug spray a must for all visitors. Related: U.S. Updates Travel Advisory for Trendy Caribbean Island U.S. Embassy Issues Guidance For Travelers Photo Illustration by Thomas Trutschel&solPhotothek via Getty Images According to the U.S. Embassy, travelers should take the following precautions and steps: Seek medical care during or after travel to the Guanacaste region if you develop symptoms. Think ahead: use EPA-registered repellent (DEET, picaridin, or IR3535), sport long sleeves and pants when practical, and stick to air-conditioned or screened-in spaces whenever possible. Remove standing water at your accommodations, since Aedes mosquitoes breed in small containers of stagnant water. Prevention through bite avoidance remains the primary defense as there is no vaccine available. MEDINDIA MEDINDIA Consult Online Doctor Courses Explore Healthy Living News Health A-Z Calculators Articles Drugs Directories Education More Search Medindia Medindia » News » Environmental Health » New Rapid Test Spots Mosquito-Borne Viruses at Ultralow Levels New Rapid Test Spots Mosquito-Borne Viruses at Ultralow Levels by Shravanthi Vikram on Jul 20 2026 1:40 PM Listen to this article 0:00/0:00 Researchers have developed a highly sensitive test strip that visually detects chikungunya virus without complex laboratory equipment, offering potential for field surveillance and low-resource settings. Can a portable test strip detect mosquito-borne viruses at levels normally requiring sophisticated laboratory equipment? A new diagnostic platform suggests it may be possible. Researchers have developed a multisite bridging-mediated lateral flow immunoassay, or mbLFIA, that detected chikungunya virus at concentrations as low as 2 picomoles per litre through a visible test-strip signal. chikungunya is a viral disease transmitted mainly through the bites of infected Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. Symptoms usually begin within several days of an infected mosquito bite. The most common signs are sudden fever and severe joint pain, along with headache, muscle pain, joint swelling, fatigue or rash.(1✔ ✔Trusted SourceChikungunyaGo to source) The enzyme-free system combines molecular amplification with gold-platinum nanoparticles to strengthen the colour produced on the test line. Researchers say the platform could eventually support rapid testing, outbreak surveillance and infection control in clinics, ports, field stations and regions with limited access to laboratory instruments. Chikungunya Chikungunya is a viral disease spread by mosquito bites; it causes fever, severe joint pain and rash on the body. Chikungunya occurs in Africa, Asia and the Indian sub continent. New Test Strip Detected Chikungunya at Very Low Levels The mbLFIA platform achieved a visual detection limit of 2 pmol/L for chikungunya virus after colour enhancement. Its visual detection range extended from 2 to 10,000 pmol/L. By comparison, the assay without the additional colour-enhancement step detected concentrations from 20 to 10,000 pmol/L. This represents a tenfold improvement in the lowest visually detectable concentration. The stronger signal could make low-level viral material easier to identify without fluorescence readers or other specialised instruments. Chikungunya Virus Causes Chronic Joint Pain: Here’s HowChikungunya virus causes chronic joint pain. The mechanism by which chikungunya virus causes chronic joint pain has been deciphered using a new reporter system. This novel tool detects and isolates cells harboring viral RNA long after the initial ...Multisite Bridging Produced a Stronger Test-Line Signal Conventional lateral flow nucleic acid tests may have only a limited number of sites where colour-producing probes can bind. The researchers addressed this limitation by redesigning the amplified molecular products to contain multiple equivalent binding sites. These multisite products could connect more gold-platinum DNA probes to the test line through two bridging mechanisms. At low concentrations, the multisite design produced signals 10.8 times and 9.6 times stronger than two limited-site designs tested by the researchers. The increased number of molecular connections allowed more signal-producing particles to accumulate on the test strip. Chikungunya Threat May Spread Across North America and Europe by 2100Climate change could expand chikungunya risk into Europe, North America, and East Asia as mosquito vectors spread into cooler regions by 2100.Enzyme-Free Amplification Simplified the Detection Process The system used a two-round catalytic hairpin assembly involving four DNA hairpin probes known as H1, H2, H3 and H4. When chikungunya target RNA was present, it triggered H1 and H2 to bind together. The viral target was then released and could initiate further amplification cycles. The resulting H1-H2 complex activated H3 and H4, producing molecular structures containing multiple probe-binding sites. Because catalytic hairpin assembly does not require enzymes, the method may avoid some of the storage and handling challenges associated with enzyme-dependent tests. Research Reveals Chikungunya Test Vaccine Shows PromiseResearchers have revealed that a candidate vaccine against the joint disease chikungunya showed promise by provoking an immune response in human trials.Gold-Platinum Nanoparticles Enhanced the Visible Readout The researchers used gold-platinum, or Au@Pt, nanoparticles to further strengthen the test-strip signal. These particles have enzyme-like catalytic properties. They catalysed the oxidation of 3-amino-9-ethylcarbazole, producing an insoluble brown-red deposit on the test line. This colour deposition made low concentrations of the target easier to see with the naked eye. The team confirmed the nanoparticles’ structure and composition using techniques including transmission electron microscopy, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and X-ray diffraction. Test Distinguished Chikungunya from Other Mosquito-Borne Viruses Specificity tests showed that the chikungunya signal was substantially stronger than signals produced by other mosquito-borne viruses. The researchers tested the system against: Zika virus Dengue virus West Nile virus Yellow fever virus Japanese encephalitis virus Getah virus The findings suggest that the assay could distinguish its intended chikungunya target from several related or clinically relevant mosquito-borne viruses. Specificity is important because these infections can circulate in overlapping regions and may produce similar early symptoms. Biological Samples Did Not Prevent Detection The test was also evaluated using serum, saliva and urine samples that had been spiked with target material. Recovery rates remained between 80% and 120% across these biological sample types.(2✔ ✔Trusted SourceMultisite bridging-mediated lateral flow immunoassay for enhanced detection of mosquito-borne virusesGo to source) This suggests that substances naturally present in the samples did not prevent the assay from detecting the target. Testing across different sample types may be useful when developing future diagnostic applications. Further work is still needed to determine which clinical sample would provide the most reliable results in infected people. Preclinical Results Matched RT-PCR in 36 Mouse Samples The researchers tested the mbLFIA platform using 36 suspected chikungunya mouse serum samples. The assay identified: 16 positive samples 20 negative samples These results matched those obtained using reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction, or RT-PCR. The study reported 100% concordance, sensitivity and specificity within this small preclinical sample set. These findings are encouraging, but they do not yet establish equivalent performance in human patients. Larger studies using clinical samples from people with suspected chikungunya infection will be needed. Portable Testing Could Strengthen Mosquito-Borne Virus Surveillance Current molecular tests such as RT-PCR, loop-mediated isothermal amplification, rolling circle amplification and CRISPR-based assays can detect viral genetic material with high accuracy. However, many require enzymes, temperature control, specialised readers and trained laboratory staff, limiting their use in remote communities, border areas, outbreak sites and under-resourced health facilities.(2✔ ✔Trusted SourceMultisite bridging-mediated lateral flow immunoassay for enhanced detection of mosquito-borne virusesGo to source) The need for accessible testing is growing as climate change, international travel and trade expand the reach of chikungunya, dengue, Zika and other mosquito-borne viruses. Portable diagnostic tools could support earlier case detection and stronger outbreak surveillance without depending heavily on complex laboratory equipment. Human Trials Are Needed Before Clinical Use The new assay is not yet ready for routine patient testing because its comparison with RT-PCR involved only 36 mouse serum samples. Human studies must confirm its sensitivity at low viral levels, performance across different stages of infection, reliability in diverse populations, stability under field conditions, storage life and risk of false results. Regulatory approval would also be required before the test could enter clinical practice. Test Strip Could Support Outbreak Surveillance The mbLFIA platform offers a new strategy for improving visual detection on lateral flow strips. By combining enzyme-free molecular amplification, multisite probe binding and nanoparticle-assisted colour deposition, the test produced a stronger signal without relying on complex laboratory readers. The technology may eventually help support rapid screening in clinics, ports, field stations and low-resource areas. It could also potentially be adapted to detect other viral or microbial genetic targets by redesigning the sequence-specific probes. For now, the results provide promising preclinical evidence rather than proof of clinical effectiveness. Further testing in human samples will determine whether this highly sensitive strip can become a practical tool for controlling chikungunya and other mosquito-borne infections. analysis.brief_en: Researchers have developed a portable, enzyme-free test strip (mbLFIA) that visually detects chikungunya virus at ultralow concentrations, down to 2 picomoles per litre, without complex laboratory equipment. The platform uses multisite bridging-mediated lateral flow immunoassay combined with gold-platinum nanoparticles to enhance signal strength. Preclinical testing on 36 mouse serum samples demonstrated 100% concordance with RT-PCR and the ability to distinguish chikungunya from other mosquito-borne viruses like Zika and dengue. The technology aims to support field surveillance and outbreak detection in low-resource settings. However, the test is not yet ready for clinical use; human trials are required to confirm its performance, stability, and reliability before regulatory approval and routine patient testing can occur.

news.content_zh: 研究人员开发了一种便携式无酶测试条 (mbLFIA),无需复杂的实验室设备,即可目视检测超低浓度(低至每升 2 皮摩尔)的基孔肯雅病毒。该平台采用多位点桥接介导的侧流免疫测定法与金铂纳米粒子相结合来增强信号强度。对 36 份小鼠血清样本的临床前测试表明,与 RT-PCR 100% 一致,并且能够区分基孔肯雅热和寨卡病毒和登革热等其他蚊媒病毒。该技术旨在支持资源匮乏环境中的现场监测和疫情检测。然而,该测试尚未准备好用于临床;在进行监管批准和常规患者测试之前,需要进行人体试验来确认其性能、稳定性和可靠性。
